instruction: Take a snapshot of the video playing in VLC and save it as 'movie_frame.png' to the Desktop.

parameters.window_name: Interstellar Movie - Interstellar Movie - Official Trailer - VLC media player

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires taking a video snapshot and saving as 'movie_frame.png' on Desktop. Evaluator verifies: (1) file exists, (2) valid PNG format, (3) reasonable size (10KB-50MB). State-based evaluation without external ground truth.
